key_takeaways: k2-fsa 생태계 기반의 고품질 제로샷(Zero-shot) 음성 합성 및 음색 복제 지원

en.title: OmniVoice Interactive AI Demo - Versatile Speech Synthesis by k2-fsa
en.hook: Interactive Gradio demo showcasing k2-fsa's high-performance zero-shot speech synthesis and TTS capabilities.
key_takeaways: High-quality zero-shot voice cloning and speech generation built on the k2-fsa ecosystem
User-friendly Gradio SDK interface for real-time speech synthesis evaluation
Supports multi-speaker voice matching and robust multilingual text-to-speech tasks

zh.title: OmniVoice 交互式 AI 演示 - k2-fsa 推出的通用语音合成系统
zh.hook: 展示 k2-fsa 团队开发的高性能零样本语音合成与多语言 TTS 能力的 Gradio 实时演示
key_takeaways: 基于 k2-fsa 生态的高质量零样本 (Zero-shot) 语音克隆与生成
提供直观的 Gradio 界面，方便实时测试与评估语音合成效果
支持多语种文本转语音及灵活的说话人音色克隆
